scope: Only a preset retained by the process-confirmed mixed-load screen advances. It is tested after the current GPU queue and native memcheck.
functional: All50 verdicts must match the already qualified candidate; actual cancel state must pass.
performance_guard: Conservative observed5percent affected-cell guard for throughput, mean TTFT and mean decode. Preserve original mixed-screen constraints and also limit resident mean completion wall regression to5percent in both process pairs.
withdrawal: If related quality or bounded service checks fail, preserve the screen and withdraw only the optional preset. Default native candidate qualification remains separate.
limits: N=1 per configuration for additional affected cells. No statistical no-regression guarantee.
